description: Erection of a rear roof dormer extension with a hip to gable roof conversion and three front roof lights to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  923/P/11; 923/P/P12 (Rev B); 923/P/P13 (Rev M); 923/P/P14 (Rev E)  Received:  01 August 2023;  923/P/P10 (Rev G); 923/P/P15 (Rev C)
Received:  17 July 2023;  923/E/P1 (Rev C); 923/E/P2 (Rev B); 923/E/P3 (Rev B); 923/E/P4 (Rev C); 923/P/P5 (Rev C); 923/E/P7 (Rev A); 923/E/P8 (Rev E); 923/P/P9 (Rev E); Unreferenced Block Plan; Unreferenced Location Plan  Received:  05 April 2023.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the converted gabled roof and rear roof dormer extension hereby approved.
